title: Cash Pickup Name-Correction Fee: Payment by the Customer's Card Authorisation
content:
## The fee charge

The fee for a name correction beyond the tier's free corrections on a Cash Pickup transfer is paid by the customer's own card authorisation in the app. It is paid as one name-correction fee charge, numbered with the correction it pays for. That number is the corrections already recorded on the transfer plus one.

| Name corrections already recorded on the transfer | Number of the correction the fee pays for |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 |
| 2 | 3 |

## Expired pickups

On a pickup that has expired, a name-correction fee is fixed only after the transfer's ledger carries the reactivation fee charge for the reactivation that pickup awaits.

So while an expired pickup's ledger carries no reactivation fee charge for the reactivation it awaits, the name-correction fee on that transfer is not yet fixed.

## The tool and who runs it

The tool is `pay_name_correction_fee_e426b8ef`, and it belongs to the customer. The agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to authorise the card payment in their own name.

## What one call does

- It collects one name-correction fee charge, dated today, on the Cash Pickup transfer's money movements, numbered with the correction it pays for.
- It raises the fees Paloma holds for the transfer by the amount given.

The charge then appears among the transfer's money movements and in the fees held. The recipient name itself is not changed by this call.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `cash_transfer_id` | The reference number of the Cash Pickup transfer the fee is paid on, as returned by the Cash Pickup transfer lookup for this customer | identifier |
| `fee_seq` | The number of the name correction this fee pays for: the transfer's correction number that the fee pays for | whole integer counting from 1 |
| `amount_usd` | The fee amount in US dollars, already rounded; it is charged exactly as given | non-negative number with 2 decimal places |

## Return

A successful call returns a receipt with these fields:
- `status`: "paid" when the charge was written;
- `ledger_entry_id`: the reference of the new fee charge;
- `fee_type`: always `name_correction_fee`;
- `fee_seq`: the correction number paid for;
- `amount_usd`: the amount charged, in US dollars with 2 decimals;
- `fees_held_usd`: the fees Paloma now holds for the transfer, in US dollars with 2 decimals.
